title: feat(mcp,gen): search and filter the model catalog
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16168

## What changes

- Every Gen model-list route (`/models`, `/text|image|video|audio|embeddings|3d/models`, `/v1/models`) accepts `query`, `capabilities`, `agent` and `limit`.
- The MCP `listModels` tool forwards them next to `type` and `community`. It no longer filters agents itself, so it stays a thin proxy.

| Parameter | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `query` | Case-insensitive; every word must appear in the name, aliases, title, description or publisher |
| `capabilities` | Comma-separated; a model needs all of them; unknown values return 400 |
| `agent` | `true`/`1` agents only, `false`/`0` no agents |
| `limit` | 1-500; applied last, after visibility, key permissions, source and reliability, in catalog order |

Source size: Gen +61/-9 (`model-catalog.ts`, `schemas/models.ts`); MCP +28/-14, mostly the tool schema. `listModels` forwards, and `getModels` takes a filter object.

## Real `listModels` calls

Run through the actual MCP handler against the actual Gen worker code (Vitest workers pool, real registry):

```
listModels({})                                      GET /models                              -> 203 models
listModels({"type":"text"})                         GET /text/models                         -> 100 models
listModels({"query":"claude","limit":3})            GET /models?query=claude&limit=3         -> anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5, anthropic/claude-opus-5.5, anthropic/claude-fable-5.1
listModels({"type":"text","query":"gemini flash"})  GET /text/models?query=gemini+flash      -> 6 models (google/gemini-3.8-flash, ...-3.7-flash, ...-3.5-flash-lite, ...)
listModels({"type":"text","capabilities":["reasoning","web_search"],"limit":5})

gist.headline: Find the right flower
gist.blurb: The model catalog gets a search box, in API form. Ask for Claude, require reasoning and web search, or keep agents out of the results.
gist.summary: Gen’s model-list routes gain case-insensitive, all-word query search, all-required capability filters, agent selection, and a 1–500 result limit; MCP’s listModels forwards the same filters instead of filtering agents itself.
gist.impact: Developers can narrow model listings across text, image, video, audio, embeddings, and 3D, with limits applied after visibility and permission checks in catalog order.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy model-catalog garden: labeled code-plants represent different model types, while a small search lens and filter tags represent query and capability matching. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, helps a curious CRT monitor robot find a matching plant.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden-library, a cute chunky CRT monitor robot examines model code-plants through a little search lens while Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, points to the matching flower; the main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, small-to-medium sized and strictly pixel art. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; prominent lime green (#ecf874) foliage and glow, warm cream background, dark purple (#110518) outlines, chunky sprites, and a small pixel-font sign reading 'MODELS'.
